image_description: A close-up, studio-style shot of a white cloth diaper (nappy) against a plain white background. The diaper features a prominent waistband with two large, rectangular hook-and-loop fastening tabs. The body of the diaper shows gathered elastic ruffles at the leg openings and soft fabric folds indicating padding.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rectangular when flat, with elasticized leg openings and waistband.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly displays a defined waistband structure and distinct elasticized gathers at the leg openings, consistent with the functional geometry of a diaper.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Thickness is notably padded and bulky when uncompressed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The central body of the diaper exhibits significant volume and soft undulating folds, visually confirming a thick, padded absorbent core rather than a flat sheet.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Folded form shows layered construction with absorbent core between layers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The diaper is presented in a pre-folded/assembled state; the internal cross-section or layer separation is not visible to verify internal construction.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Fastening system uses adhesive tabs (hook-and-loop or sticky) on side panels.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Two distinct rectangular fastening tabs with visible texture (suggesting hook-and-loop material) are clearly mounted on the upper waistband panel.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elastic creates gathered ruffles at leg cuffs.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The lower lateral edges of the diaper show pronounced, regular gathering and ruffling, indicative of elastic threading used for leg containment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Size indicators and wetness strip may be visible.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No printed size markings or color-changing wetness indicator strips are visible on the exterior surface of the diaper.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Outer surface is smooth plastic or fabric-like material in white or printed patterns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The exterior appears to be a white, woven fabric material (likely cotton or PUL) with a matte finish, fitting the description of a cloth diaper outer shell.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Inner surface is soft non-woven fabric.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The interior lining of the diaper is completely occluded by the folded shape and angle of the photograph.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Absorbent padded core with waterproof outer layer.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the bulk suggests a core, the specific material properties (waterproof vs. absorbent) cannot be visually verified without seeing the layers or testing.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture on the fastening tabs appears slightly 'melted' or painterly. The parallel lines representing the hook/loop mechanism lack crisp definition and seem to blend into the surrounding fabric border, suggesting minor generative smoothing.

The elastic gathering on the right side loses some structural coherence near the bottom edge, where the ruffles appear to merge slightly with the shadow/background rather than maintaining distinct physical folds.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a diaper/nappy and distinguish it from similar garments like underwear or shorts.
To audit the continuity of the fabric edges and ensure the elastic ruffles are physically connected to the main body without floating artifacts.
To analyze the micro-texture of the white fabric and fastening tabs for signs of AI-generated blurring or inconsistent noise patterns.

Fabric weave consistency across light and shadow areas
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the fastening tabs; AI often struggles to render the specific mechanical texture of hook-and-loop fasteners, resulting in smeared lines. Also, verify if the shadows under the elastic ruffles are consistent with a single light source, as inconsistent shading can indicate geometric hallucination.
